answer: Proof of Stake serves as a digital atlas for resource allocation, mandating that agents lock capital to validate transactions. This economic voyage creates an ivory tower of security where identity is tied to financial skin-in-the-game. An attacker attempting a Sybil strike faces a prohibitive cost, as they must acquire a majority of the circulating supply to compromise the network, rendering the mass creation of fake accounts mathematically irrational and economically devastating.
